value.rationale: The four primes 3,7,11,13 are the irredundant R_6 prime support needed to certify the original 231 exception. Complete classification of this natural minimal covering subsystem quantitatively resolves the prevalence of certified odd-length, non-11 prime-free cores: lower and upper natural densities 1/33033 and 10/33033 and logarithmic density 1/6006. These are motivated sharp arithmetic invariants beyond the original isolated examples and sufficient algorithm.
